{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
complete_data = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Check if the missing rows are different in other variables
# Specifically, check if they are systematically different in sex, species, or island
# We already know they are Adelie (Torgersen) and Gentoo (Biscoe)
# Now check the full dataset vs. missing rows for sex
full_sex_dist = penguins['sex'].value_counts(normalize=True)
missing_sex_dist = penguins.loc[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull() | penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull(), 'sex'].value_counts(normalize=True)

print("Full dataset sex proportions:")
print(full_sex_dist)

print("\nMissing rows sex proportions:")
print(missing_sex_dist)"}
